entity_types: Associations (associações) via public deed (escritura pública) at Serviços Notariais under the Código Civil (10+ founders); registry number via Conservatória de Registo Comercial, Predial e Automóvel; Decree 23/92 NGO route inoperative (SOLIDAMI abolished).
cost_time: Fees (2021 IMVF study, Despacho 04/2002): name check 7,500 CFA; deed 12,650-113,496 CFA; registry number to 57,500 CFA; publication 15,000 CFA + 10,000 CFA/pg; total ~93k-300k CFA (~$150-500). Time: name check ~7 days, deed ~5 days; full duration unpublished.
foreign_no_presence: no - Requires a physical public deed in Portuguese at the Serviços Notariais (Bissau only) plus 10+ founding members; no remote channel for foreign founders (Constitution art. 44d grants the right to citizens; IMVF 2021 study s4.2, s4.2.4).
corrections: Mechanism: notarial registration under the Código Civil (Decreto 23/92 opinion route inoperative); cited 2013 law unverified; fees per 2021 IMVF study (~93k-300k CFA).
